questions.question: The number of misprints found in books printed by three printing / presses are recorded below. Use One-way ANOVA to test whether there is a significant difference. Press A Press B Press C 4 5 6 5 6 7 6 7 8
questions.solution_html:
• Null Hypothesis: There is no significant difference between the means
  • Alternate Hypothesis: At least one of the means is not equal - (1 mark)
  • T=15+18+21=54, N=3+3+3=9, Correction Factor=T2/N= 324 - (2 marks)
  • Total Sum of Squares=12 - (1 mark)
  • Sum of Squares between Columns=6 - (1 mark)
  • Error Sum of Squares=12-6=6 - (1 mark)
  • Mean Sum of Squares(C)=6/2=3 - (0.5 mark)
  • Mean Sum of Squares(E)=6/6=1 - (0.5 mark)
  • F statistic=3 - (1 mark)
  • F at 5% level of significance=4.26 - (1 mark)
  • (2,6)
  • Calculated value of F
  • - (1 mark)

questions.question: A survey of radio listeners’ preference for two types of music under / various age groups gave the following information. Is preference for type of music influenced by age? Use 5% level of significance. Type of Music 19–25 26–35 Above 36 Carnatic music 80 60 90 Film music 210 325 44 Indifferent 16 45 132
questions.solution_html:
• Null Hypothesis: Preference for type of music and age are independent
  • Alternate Hypothesis: Preference for type of music and age are dependent - (1 mark)
  • The Expected frequencies are 70.24, 176.82, 58.94, 98.7, 248.47, 82.82, 61.06, 153.27
  • 51.24 - (3 marks)
  • Chi-square statistic=314.18 - (4 marks)
  • ϰ2 at 5% level of significance=9.488 - (1 mark)
  • (4)
  • Calculated value of Chi square >Tabled value of Chi square . Therefore, Reject Null
  • Hypothesis. - (1 mark)
